messages:
eva-sales: Lyra exec asked for an EOW unblock. Blockers: SSO (SAML + SCIM), EU-only pilot, and a 20% pilot concession request. Need an exec-ready summary.

marc-se: We support SAML 2.0 (IdP & SP). For a fast test we need IdP metadata + 2 test users + allowlist for EU test IPs. Can spin up a feature-flagged EU SP endpoint.

nate-infra: EU-only Dedicated pilot possible. Lead time ~48-72h after approval. Cost est: €2,600/week. Need a capacity ticket to proceed.

ash-cs: Lyra needs logs retained <30 days and no transcript export outside EU during pilot. Also asked for a named technical contact.

sophie-legal: Any concession >15% needs Deal Desk + VP signoff. Post ARR and exact pilot term here and I'll route for expedited review.

eva-sales: ARR est: €95k. Pilot term: 4 weeks. They requested 20% off pilot fees (first 4 weeks only). Posting metadata request to customer now.

ops-bot: infra-ticket DP-9001 created by nate-infra  Dedicated pilot queued, est provisioning 72h after approval.

marc-se: Test plan (short): 1) Upload IdP metadata to EU SP endpoint 2) SP-initiated login with 2 test users 3) Validate SCIM provisioning (email,name,groups) 4) Confirm group-based access. Ping me when metadata is posted.

sophie-legal: Routing to Deal Desk now. Will update in ~2h. If VP needs more detail, I'll post the one-pager here.

eva-sales: Next steps: customer posts metadata + test users, legal routes concession, infra waits for approval then provisions. Target: decision by Fri COB. Will escalate to VP if blocked.
